newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabena adds Swiss, Austrian, and U.S. flights.
newsitem.headline: Sabena adds Swiss, Austrian, and U.S. flights.

text.p: Swissair subsidiary Crossair will fly Brussels to Berne six times a week this winter in a code-sharing agreement with Belgium's Sabena, Sabena said on Monday.
It said Brussels to Basle flights would be doubled to six a week.

In cooperation with Austrian Airlines, Salzbourg and Linz will be serviced twice daily, and a flight from Brussels to Thessalonika, via Vienna, introduced. An agreement with Finnair allows a fourth daily Brussels to Stockholm flight.

Sabena said code-sharing agreements with Delta would see Dallas, Fort Lauderdale, Houston, New Orleans, San Francisco, Denver, Los Angeles, Washington, Cincinnati and Salt Lake City added to its U.S. destinations from October 27.
